description: The asynchronous messaging statements RECEIVE (ISO §2023:14.9.31) and SEND (§2023:14.9.38) — a COBOL-2023 introduction (§2023:E.3.2 item 1). The facility is provided (Annex A.3 item 4; docs/CONFORMANCE.md §2 row 4, kb/Work PB4744): at 2023 each statement binds and exchanges messages between run units. Both grammar arms are the UNION grammar, predicated only on the verb's spelling, because §2023:8.9 reserves RECEIVE and SEND at 85 (the '85 communication module) and again at 2023 with a user-word gap between; the VersionConformancePass parse arm (VisitMessagingReceiveStatement / VisitMessagingSendStatement) names the edition on RECOGNITION, so 85, 2002 and 2014 all answer COBOL0900 (kb/Work PB374: the reservation predicate had compiled the 2023 formats at --std 85 under a warning naming the 2023 facility). The SEND writes its END-SEND: §2023:14.9.38.2 prints it without brackets in both formats, so its omission is refused at 2023 (COBOL1850, kb/Work PB2024).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. AMG.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-TAG USAGE MESSAGE-TAG.
01 WS-MSG PIC X(20).
01 WS-LEN PIC 9(4).
01 WS-REPLY USAGE MESSAGE-TAG.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    RECEIVE FROM WS-TAG GIVING WS-MSG WS-LEN.
    SEND TO WS-SRV FROM WS-MSG RETURNING WS-REPLY END-SEND.
    STOP RUN.
